listings.name: Merse Wellness Osborne Park
listings.address: 454 Scarborough Beach Rd, Osborne Park WA 6019
listings.blurb: Merse Wellness Osborne Park is a bathhouse on Scarborough Beach Road with hot magnesium spas, cold plunge pools, hot rock and infrared saunas, a steam room and monsoon showers. Bathhouse sessions usually run 60 to 90 minutes. The steam room is open to members and casual visitors, with bookings through the Merse app. A Rejuvenate Lounge offers compression, LED light and sound sessions. Open weekdays 5.30am to 9pm, weekends 7am to 7pm.

listings.name: Revive Skin Emporium
listings.address: Shop 2, 416-418 Oxford St, Mount Hawthorn WA 6016
listings.blurb: Revive Skin Emporium is a day spa on the corner of Oxford Street and Scarborough Beach Road in Mount Hawthorn, with private treatment rooms for singles and couples, a hydrotherapy spa and a steam room. The steam room can be booked on its own as a 30-minute session ($45 for one, $70 for two), paired with the spa, or before a massage, wrap or scrub. Massages start at $145 for 30 minutes. Open Monday to Saturday, closed Sundays.

listings.name: Recwell
listings.blurb: Recwell is a contrast therapy and recovery centre in Wangara with hot and cold pools, a steam room, a campfire sauna, a compression boot lounge and Reformer Pilates. Contrast sessions run 60 minutes and include the pools, sauna and steam room, booked as casual sessions, packs or week-to-week memberships from $49 a week for two sessions. Remedial massage and physiotherapy run on site through outside providers. Open weekdays 5.30am to 8pm and weekends 7am to 4pm.
